mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.homework_record_id, ar.status, ar.ai_score, ar.ai_comment, ar.ai_confidence FROM edu_homework_ai_review ar JOIN ( SELECT homework_record_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM edu_homework_ai_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND homework_record_id IN #{id} GROUP BY homework_record_id ) latest ON latest.id = ar.id WHERE ar.deleted = 0
